title: The Whole Postcard
author: Orsen Amberdale
blurb: Emrys Almeida, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, has spent twenty years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must forgive the person in the mirror first before the festival ends.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
